correctness.rationale: Proof reconstructs the exhaustive sign-coordinate class, normalizations V=8xyz/3 and delta=2C, and solid-angle identity Omega=2atan(2xyz/Q). Ordering x<=y<=z gives y^2B+z^2A>=ABC; the exact identity A^2B^2-2xyzC=x^4+(xC-yz)^2>0 gives Q^2>8xyzC^3. Therefore Omega^2<6mu with strictness. A three-factor identity proves sharpness and the iff degeneration criterion. The embedded verifier replays independently, but the proof is analytic and not based on finite sampling.

value.rationale: Determines the exact shape-regularity coefficient for all equifacial tetrahedra, a natural symmetry class underlying canonical sliver obstructions in 3D mesh quality. It closes the full-class benchmark at the coefficient 6 established previously only as a necessary asymptotic lower obstruction, and classifies every approach-to-equality degeneration. It is not an isolated parameter slice or a general-tetrahedron theorem.
